quotes: A foodstuff trading license starts from AED 12,500 at Meydan Free Zone.
You need a foodstuff trading license that lists your specific activities, such as importing, exporting, or re-exporting food products.
Additional costs may apply for Dubai Municipality approvals, food label registrations, and FIT analyses depending on your products.
